### The Benefits are Built In

unique lifestyle. You can easily update playlists, adjust scenes, and modify lighting. As your needs
change, your Control4 system will adapt, allowing you to create a home or business space that suits

### Customizable Systems

Keep your smart system at your fingertips with the Control4 app. You'll get push notifications,

### Professional Integrators

Our certified integration professionals ensure your project is correctly installed, reliable,
scalable, and personalized to your life for a seamless, smart experience. They'll be there every

Your system will work with thousands of Control4 and third-party products to transform your favorite
devices into one cohesive smart home system. Manage them all with a simple tap, a single voice
command, or even allow things to happen automatically with no interaction at all.

Sensors, 1 Vivint Motion Sensor, 1 Vivint Keypad, and 1 Vivint yard sign. The HomeProtect equipment
package is regularly priced at $349.99, with professional installation priced at $199 and Vivint
system monitoring at $29.99/mo., unless otherwise advertised. Offer for new Vivint customers only.

**HomeProtect Pro Offer Terms **

The HomeProtect Pro Offer is available to new and existing Vivint customers and requires a minimum
$749.99 expenditure on equipment (after discounts), professional installation and execution of a
Vivint services agreement. Monthly service fees vary based on the products and services you select.
HomeProtect system purchases and reactivations of previously-installed systems are not eligible for
this offer.

**Financing Options**

Financing for equipment purchases is subject to credit approval by one of Vivint’s third-party
financing partners. Qualified customers may finance at 0% APR for up to 60 months, with terms
varying by offer. Financing requires a separate agreement with the financing partner. Month-to-month
service agreements are available when equipment is purchased upfront.

System can support multiple cameras, subject to sufficient WiFi speeds. Without a Vivint services
plan, product and system functionality is limited (including loss of remote connectivity). Contact a

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

# Mixers and showers that set the standard

[The AXOR One Faucet in Polished Red Gold]

## Iconic objects for design bathrooms

AXOR conceives and manufactures iconic objects for luxury bathrooms. Developed in collaboration with
world-renowned designers—Philippe Starck, Antonio Citterio, Jean-Marie Massaud and Barber Osgerby
among them—the [AXOR collections ][146]feature products in a wide variety of styles for the
[washbasin][147], [bathtub][148] and [shower][149]. To ensure a consistent visual language
throughout any design bathroom, AXOR also offers a comprehensive range of [bathroom
accessories][150]. In addition to [mixers][151], [showers][152] and [accessories][153], AXOR
products for design bathrooms include [thermostatic valves ][154]and [waste systems][155] featuring
advanced AXOR [concealed installation technology][156].

[An AXOR Citterio kitchen mixer in Matt Black]

## Distinctive mixers for design kitchens

AXOR [kitchen mixers][157] bring exceptional design, intuitive technology and precision engineering
to any luxury kitchen. Developed in collaboration with Philippe Starck, Antonio Citterio and Phoenix
Design, AXOR kitchen mixers ensure effortless ease of operation for all who appreciate the art of
cooking, from amateur gastronomes to professional chefs de cuisine. Available in up to 15 exclusive
[AXOR FinishPlus][158] surfaces, AXOR [kitchen mixers][159] can be personalized to suit the style of
any design kitchen.

[Portraits of internationally acclaimed AXOR design partners]

## Leaders in design. Partners with AXOR.

AXOR partners with some of the world’s leading designers and architects to create iconic objects for
luxury bathrooms and kitchens. From [Philippe Starck][160] to [Barber Osgerby][161], [Antonio
Citterio][162] to [Jean-Marie Massaud][163], [Patricia Urquiola][164] to [nendo][165], [Phoenix
Design][166] to [Front][167], each AXOR design partner brings his, her or their individual style to
collections and products developed and manufactured by AXOR to the highest standards of quality.
Together with these renowned design partners, AXOR inspires and helps to enable architects, interior
designers and the design-savvy public to shape water-related spaces that reflect the unique
personality of the user.

**Hey friends,**

# We’re Drew Barrymore Cookware, A Kitchen Appliances Manufacturer

Our brand Drew Barrymore Cookware, Beautiful by Drew Barrymore, is a collaboration between the
renowned actress Drew Barrymore and kitchenware manufacturer Made by Gather, offering a stylish and
high-performing ceramic non-stick cookware.
[ Learn more ][8]

## Drew Barrymore Cooking Appliances

Combining Drew Barrymore’s iconic style with high-performance functionality, the Beautiful
Kitchenware brand offers a range of versatile and aesthetically-pleasing appliances for the modern
kitchen.

### Drew Barrymore Crockpot

The crockpot is a versatile 6-quart, 5-in-1 programmable slow cooker with low, high, and keep warm
heat settings, designed for dishes like meat, poultry, stew, and chili.

### Drew Barrymore Air Fryer

The Beautiful by Drew Barrymore 6-Quart Air Fryer is a 1,700-watt appliance with functions like Air
Fry, Roast, Reheat, and Dehydrate, available in stylish colors.

### Drew Barrymore Coffee Maker

The Beautiful Coffee Maker brews extra hot coffee without compromising flavor using a 1200-watt
system that can be programmed 24 hours in advance.

### Drew Barrymore Stand Mixer

The Beautiful 5.3QT Tilt-Head Stand Mixer has a 300-watt mixing system capable of mixing up to 9
dozen cookies, with 12 speeds and a tilt-head design.

### Drew Barrymore Toaster

The Beautiful 2-Slice Toaster has a 1800-watt extra wide self-adjusting slot design with 7 browning
settings and preset buttons.

### Drew Barrymore Slow Cooker

The Beautiful by Drew Barrymore Mini Slow Cooker Set includes two compact versatile slow cookers,
available for $15 at Walmart or Amazon.

## Drew Barrymore Cookware Bestsellers

[12pc Ceramic Non-Stick Cookware Set]

### 12pc Ceramic Non-Stick Cookware Set

The 12-piece Drew Barrymore Beautiful ceramic non-stick cookware set features a durable, sleek
design with gold die-cast handles and lids, oven-safe up to 500°F, compatible with all stovetops
including induction, and includes an 8″ fry pan, 10″ fry pan, 3qt sauté pan, 2qt saucepan, 5qt Dutch
oven, and 4 cookware protectors, all made with a non-toxic, PTFE/PFOA/PFOS-free ceramic coating.

[ Check Price ][9]

### Drew Barrymore Touchscreen Slow Cooker

The Beautiful by Drew Barrymore 6QT Programmable Touchscreen Slow Cooker is a stylish and versatile
oval-shaped appliance made of durable stainless steel, with a large 6-quart capacity for
family-sized meals, featuring an intuitive touch-activated digital display that allows you to
conveniently program cooking times and temperatures with precision for perfectly tender, flavorful
slow-cooked dishes every time.

[ Check Price ][10]

### Drew Barrymore 5 in 1 Electric Skillet

This skillet offers exceptional versatility with its adjustable 5QT to 7QT capacity, featuring a
powerful 1500-watt heating system with 5 temperature settings, a tempered glass lid with steam vent,
and a durable steel construction with a premium soft matte finish that is fully immersible and
dishwasher-safe for easy cleaning, allowing you to sauté, steam, simmer, slow cook, and serve
buffet-style all in one convenient appliance.

[ Check Price ][11]

The durable construction with gold die-cast handles and lids that can withstand oven temperatures up

### [ Color Choices ][14]

The range of vibrant color choices like Sage Green, White Icing, and Black Sesame that complement

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

Frequently Asked Questions

Whether it is product functions, maintenance suggestions, or order processing, we have prepared
clear and practical answers for you.

If you can't find your question, please feel free to contact us; we will serve you wholeheartedly!

FAQ
How do I choose the right kitchen appliance for my needs?

Our kitchen appliance series is categorized according to different needs. You can choose the right
product according to your cooking habits, the number of family members, and the frequency of use.
For example, if you like healthy drinks, you can choose our slow juicer; if you need a
multi-functional kitchen assistant, we recommend our 3-in-1 blender or 4-in-1 juicer. You can also
contact our customer service team, and we will provide you with professional advice based on your
needs.

What should I do if my product fails?

We provide a full range of after-sales services. If your product fails, please first check the
common troubleshooting methods in the product manual. If the problem is not solved, you can contact
us through our after-sales support channels, provide purchase information and fault description, and
we will handle it for you as soon as possible and provide repair or replacement services.

Do Jiaolong Electric's products meet international certification standards?

Yes, all Jiaolong Electric's products meet international quality and safety certification standards,
such as CE, RoHS, ISO9001, etc. We strictly comply with various safety and environmental protection
requirements to ensure that each product is of high quality and safety to meet the needs of the
global market.

How do I clean and maintain my kitchen appliances?

We recommend that you clean your kitchen appliances regularly to ensure their long life. Generally,
wipe the exterior with a damp cloth and avoid soaking in water. The cleaning methods for different
products vary. You can refer to the cleaning suggestions and precautions provided in the product
manual. Some removable parts such as the pulp cup of the juicer and the blades of the blender can be
cleaned separately. If you need a detailed maintenance guide, please refer to our official website
or contact customer service.

Where can I buy Jiaolong Electric's products?

Our products can be purchased through our official website. In addition, we also cooperate with many
dealers and retailers around the world. You can find our products in local appliance stores and
online e-commerce platforms (such as Amazon, Tmall, JD.com, etc.). If you have any questions about
the purchase channel, you can also contact our customer service team at any time and we will help
you.

Frequently Asked Questions

Whether it is product functions, maintenance suggestions, or order processing, we have prepared
clear and practical answers for you.

If you can't find your question, please feel free to contact us; we will serve you wholeheartedly!

FAQ
How do I choose the right kitchen appliance for my needs?

Our kitchen appliance series is categorized according to different needs. You can choose the right
product according to your cooking habits, the number of family members, and the frequency of use.
For example, if you like healthy drinks, you can choose our slow juicer; if you need a
multi-functional kitchen assistant, we recommend our 3-in-1 blender or 4-in-1 juicer. You can also
contact our customer service team, and we will provide you with professional advice based on your
needs.

What should I do if my product fails?

We provide a full range of after-sales services. If your product fails, please first check the
common troubleshooting methods in the product manual. If the problem is not solved, you can contact
us through our after-sales support channels, provide purchase information and fault description, and
we will handle it for you as soon as possible and provide repair or replacement services.

Do Jiaolong Electric's products meet international certification standards?

Yes, all Jiaolong Electric's products meet international quality and safety certification standards,
such as CE, RoHS, ISO9001, etc. We strictly comply with various safety and environmental protection
requirements to ensure that each product is of high quality and safety to meet the needs of the
global market.

How do I clean and maintain my kitchen appliances?

We recommend that you clean your kitchen appliances regularly to ensure their long life. Generally,
wipe the exterior with a damp cloth and avoid soaking in water. The cleaning methods for different
products vary. You can refer to the cleaning suggestions and precautions provided in the product
manual. Some removable parts such as the pulp cup of the juicer and the blades of the blender can be
cleaned separately. If you need a detailed maintenance guide, please refer to our official website
or contact customer service.

Where can I buy Jiaolong Electric's products?

Our products can be purchased through our official website. In addition, we also cooperate with many
dealers and retailers around the world. You can find our products in local appliance stores and
online e-commerce platforms (such as Amazon, Tmall, JD.com, etc.). If you have any questions about
the purchase channel, you can also contact our customer service team at any time and we will help
you.

## Why Choose Mr. Appliance for Appliance Repair?

## Why Choose Mr. Appliance for Appliance Repair?
* ### Flexible Scheduling and Quick Repairs
  
  To start, we work the hours best for you. That means we can schedule morning or afternoon
  appointments if they are more convenient. We also make the effort to keep replacement parts in
  stock, as we know having them on hand allows us to make home appliance repairs and commercial
  appliance repairs that are quicker and ultimately more expedient.
* ### Professional Assessments and Upfront Pricing
  
  When we arrive promptly for your scheduled appointment, we'll take the time to thoroughly assess
  the condition of your appliance and diagnose the issue that is giving you trouble. We'll then
  clearly explain our recommendations for the best course of action to get it repaired and offer an
  upfront quote for the work that needs to be done.
* ### We Ensure Your Satisfaction
  
  We guarantee all of our repair parts and service for one year according to our [Neighborly Done
  Right Promise^{®}][120]. Our dedicated team of appliance repair technicians is backed by a solid
  reputation. Check out our customer reviews to see why customers love our appliance repair
  services!

## We Repair and Service All Major Appliances

Finding a reliable local appliance repair company you can trust is easy with Mr. Appliance. We're
trained and equipped to service and repair all major brands of appliances. Learn more by visiting
the service pages below.
* [Mr. Appliance tech working on washing machine.]

  Schedule your washing machine repair service to limit the risk of water damage or further
  complications.

* [Mr. Appliance tech putting a sticker on an oven.]
  
  ### [ Oven Repair, Stove Repair, Range Repair ][124]
  
  Mr. Appliance repairs and services ranges, stoves, ovens, and cooktops. We're also well-versed in
  gas stove repair and electric range repair services.
  
  [ Learn More ][125] [ Oven Repair, Stove Repair, Range Repair ][126]
  [White oven icon on blue background.]
* [Mr. Appliance tech putting a sticker on a refrigerator.]
  
  ### [ Refrigerator Repair ][127]
  
  No matter the type of fridge repair issue, our team of experienced service professionals will get
  your appliance working properly again.
  
  [ Learn More ][128] [ Refrigerator Repair ][129]
  [White refrigerator icon on blue background.]
* [Mr. Appliance tech and customer looking inside a dishwasher.]
  
  ### [ Dishwasher Repair ][130]
  
  Common dishwasher problems include leaking, not draining, and not cleaning your dishes. Learn more
  about our dishwasher repair process.
  
  [ Learn More ][131] [ Dishwasher Repair ][132]
  [White dishwasher icon on blue background.]
* [Mr. Appliance tech working on commercial dryer.]
  
  ### [ Commercial Services ][133]
  
  Mr. Appliance provides appliance repair for your business, from kitchen appliances to laundry
  equipment. Learn more about the commercial services we offer.
  
  [ Learn More ][134] [ Commercial Services ][135]
  [White screwdriver and bolt icon on blue background.]

## Why Choose Mr. Appliance for Appliance Repair?

## Why Choose Mr. Appliance for Appliance Repair?
* ### Flexible Scheduling and Quick Repairs
  
  To start, we work the hours best for you. That means we can schedule morning or afternoon
  appointments if they are more convenient. We also make the effort to keep replacement parts in
  stock, as we know having them on hand allows us to make home appliance repairs and commercial
  appliance repairs that are quicker and ultimately more expedient.
* ### Professional Assessments and Upfront Pricing
  
  When we arrive promptly for your scheduled appointment, we'll take the time to thoroughly assess
  the condition of your appliance and diagnose the issue that is giving you trouble. We'll then
  clearly explain our recommendations for the best course of action to get it repaired and offer an
  upfront quote for the work that needs to be done.
* ### We Ensure Your Satisfaction
  
  We guarantee all of our repair parts and service for one year according to our [Neighborly Done
  Right Promise^{®}][120]. Our dedicated team of appliance repair technicians is backed by a solid
  reputation. Check out our customer reviews to see why customers love our appliance repair
  services!

trained and equipped to service and repair all major brands of appliances. Learn more by visiting
the service pages below.

بیش از 200 نمایندگی فعال در سراسر کشور، آماده ارائه خدمات تعمیر رایگان بدون نیاز به مراجعه حضوری و
ثبت درخواست از طریق وبسایت ناساسرویس

##### ۲ سال گارانتی محصولات

2 سال گارانتی برای تمامی محصولات خانه و آشپزخانه ناساالکتریک با فعال‌سازی سریع از طریق پیامک یا وب‌سایت
خدمات پس از فروش

## پنکه

NS-1121
* ریموت کنترل و تایمر 1 تا 12 ساعت
* سیستم چرخش اتوماتیک 100 درجه
* موتور DC با توان 90 وات و باددهی قوی
[مشاهده محصول][75]

## آسیاب قهوه

NS-1951
* توان 200 وات با 31 درجه تنظیم آسیاب
* ظرفیت 300 گرم دانه ورودی
* پنل دیجیتال با تایمر 1-60 ثانیه
[مشاهده محصول][76]

## چای ساز

NS-523
* مجهز به light design BLUE جهت القای حس بهتر
* دارای ترموستات حساس به اتمام آب مخزن، جهت خاموشی خودکار
* مجهز به STEAM SWITCH جهت عملکرد یکسان در نقاط مختلف
[مشاهده محصول][77]

## سرخ‌کن رژیمی

NS-814
* ظرفیت 7 لیتر و توان مصرفی 1800 وات
* تنظیم دما از 80 تا 200°C و تایمر 0-60 دقیقه
* پنل دیجیتال لمسی با قابلیت خاموشی خودکار
[مشاهده محصول][78]

## آون توستر

NS-2041
* توان گرمایشی قدرتمند 2100 وات
* ظرفیت بزرگ 40 لیتر با عملکرد چندکاره
* سیستم گرمایش حرفه‌ای با المنت‌های کربنی و هالوژنی
[مشاهده محصول][79]

## زودپز

NS-3076
* مجهز به دیسک منعطف جهت عملکرد پایدار و دقیق سویچ فشار
* مجهز به سیستم هشدار خطای عملکرد
* سوپاپ اطمینان برای تخلیه بخار اضافی
[مشاهده محصول][80]

## چرا ناسا الکتریک؟

##### خدمات تعمیر رایگان

بیش از 200 نمایندگی فعال در سراسر کشور، آماده ارائه خدمات تعمیر رایگان بدون نیاز به مراجعه حضوری و
ثبت درخواست از طریق وبسایت ناساسرویس

##### ۲ سال گارانتی محصولات

2 سال گارانتی برای تمامی محصولات خانه و آشپزخانه ناساالکتریک با فعال‌سازی سریع از طریق پیامک یا وب‌سایت
خدمات پس از فروش

##### تضمین تأمین قطعات

تأمین قطعات اصلی و مورد نیاز از طریق نمایندگان مجاز ناسا سرویس در سراسر کشور، همراه با امکان ثبت
سفارش آسان

## پنکه NS-1120
* موتور AC قدرتمند 100 وات با پرتاب باد تا 30 کیلومتر بر ساعت
* طراحی برجکی کم‌جا با چرخش خودکار 120 درجه
* تایمر 8 ساعته با نمایشگر LED

[
مشاهده محصول
][81]

* فولاد ضدزنگ گرید 304 (استنلس استیل 304)

* کنترل‌کننده دمای Strix با توان 10 آمپر (ساخت انگلستان)

خانواده‌های ایرانی است؛ تجربه‌ای که در آن طراحی هوشمند، عملکرد قابل اعتماد و توجه به نیازهای واقعی
نیازهای امروز دست در دست هم، به زندگی روزمره معنا و آرامش می‌بخشند. ما به آینده‌ای فکر می‌کنیم که در آن
«خانه»، نه فقط محل زندگی، بلکه فضایی برای آرامش، آسایش و الهام باشد.

## MyMini Reviews

Our customers love their MyMini appliances! Here are some of their experiences:

As a college student living in a cramped dorm room, my MyMini Personal Electric Skillet & Rapid
Noodle Maker has been an absolute game-changer. When I first unpacked it, I was impressed by its
compact size - it fit perfectly on my tiny desk without taking up too much space. The first night I
used it, I made a quick stir-fry with some vegetables and pre-cooked chicken. I was amazed at how
quickly it heated up and how evenly it cooked my meal. The non-stick surface is a dream to clean,
which is crucial when you're sharing a communal kitchen sink with an entire floor of students. I've
used it to make everything from scrambled eggs for breakfast to late-night ramen when I'm studying.
The cool-touch handles are a great safety feature, especially in a small space where accidents could
easily happen. One of my favorite things about this appliance is its versatility. Last week, I even
managed to make a small batch of pancakes for a weekend brunch with my roommate. The indicator
lights are super helpful - I always know exactly when it's preheated and ready to use. The only
minor drawback I've found is that the cooking surface is a bit small if you're trying to cook for
more than one person. But for individual meals, it's perfect. Overall, this MyMini appliance has
made dorm life so much easier and has allowed me to eat healthier, home-cooked meals instead of
relying on the campus cafeteria. It's definitely been worth every penny!
Sarah Johnson
College Student
In my line of work, I spend a lot of time on the road, staying in various hotels. The MyMini Waffle
Maker has become my trusty companion, adding a touch of home comfort to my travels. When I first
purchased it, I was skeptical about its performance given its small size, but it has exceeded my
expectations in every way. The compact design makes it incredibly easy to pack in my suitcase. It
barely takes up any space, which is crucial when you're living out of a bag. The first time I used
it in a hotel room, I was impressed by how quickly it heated up - in just about 2 minutes, it was
ready to go. I poured in the batter (I usually mix a small batch in a travel container before
leaving home), closed the lid, and in a few minutes, I had a perfectly crisp, golden waffle. What I
love most about this little powerhouse is its versatility. Sure, it makes great waffles, but I've
experimented with other recipes too. One morning, when I was craving something savory, I made a
cheese and herb waffle that turned out delicious. I've even used it to make a quick grilled cheese
sandwich when I didn't feel like going out for dinner. The non-stick surface is a lifesaver.
Cleaning up in a hotel room can be challenging, but with this waffle maker, a quick wipe with a damp
cloth is usually all it needs. The cool-touch handle is another great feature - it gives me peace of
mind when I'm using it in small hotel rooms where space can be tight. One small issue I've
encountered is that the waffle size is quite small, so if you're really hungry, you might need to
make a couple. But for me, that's not a big deal - I'd rather have a compact appliance that I can
easily travel with than a larger one that makes bigger waffles. This MyMini Waffle Maker has truly
transformed my mornings on the road. It's given me the ability to start my day with a warm, homemade
breakfast no matter where I am. The comfort and convenience it provides make those long weeks away
from home a little more bearable. It's become such an essential part of my travel kit that I can't
imagine hitting the road without it now!
Thomas Rodriguez
Traveling Salesman
After downsizing to a smaller apartment, I was on the hunt for compact appliances that wouldn't
clutter my limited counter space. That's when I discovered the MyMini 7 Egg Cooker, and it's been a
delightful addition to my kitchen. Despite its small footprint, this little dynamo has become one of
my most-used appliances. When I first unboxed it, I was impressed by its sleek design and intuitive
controls. The instruction manual was clear and concise, which I greatly appreciated. For my
inaugural use, I decided to make some hard-boiled eggs for a salad. I was amazed at how simple the
process was - I just filled the base with the appropriate amount of water (using the included
measuring cup), placed the eggs in the tray, and turned it on. The indicator light let me know when
the eggs were done, and to my delight, they were cooked to perfection. What I love most about this
egg cooker is its versatility. I've used it to make soft-boiled eggs for my grandson's breakfast
when he visits, medium-boiled eggs for my husband's sandwich lunches, and hard-boiled eggs for
various recipes. The egg white separator that comes with it is a fantastic bonus - it's made
preparing deviled eggs for potlucks so much easier. One feature that I find particularly helpful is
the auto shut-off function. As someone who occasionally gets distracted, it's reassuring to know
that I won't overcook the eggs or leave the appliance running if I forget about it. The non-stick
surface of the egg tray makes cleanup a breeze, which is a big plus for me. I've even found uses for
this appliance beyond just cooking eggs. The steaming tray that comes with it is perfect for
steaming small portions of vegetables. Last week, I used it to steam some broccoli while I was
preparing the rest of my dinner, and it came out perfectly crisp-tender. If I had to mention one
drawback, it would be that the capacity is limited to 7 eggs. When I'm preparing for larger family
gatherings, I sometimes need to do two batches. However, given how quickly it cooks the eggs, this
isn't a significant issue for me. Overall, my MyMini 7 Egg Cooker has become an indispensable part
of my kitchen. It's made preparing healthy, protein-rich meals so much easier, and its compact size
means it doesn't overwhelm my small kitchen. For anyone living in a small space or just looking to
simplify their cooking routine, I can't recommend this appliance enough. It's proof that good things
really do come in small packages!
Emily Milestone
Retired Teacher

## MyMini Reviews

Our customers love their MyMini appliances! Here are some of their experiences:

As a college student living in a cramped dorm room, my MyMini Personal Electric Skillet & Rapid
Noodle Maker has been an absolute game-changer. When I first unpacked it, I was impressed by its
compact size - it fit perfectly on my tiny desk without taking up too much space. The first night I
used it, I made a quick stir-fry with some vegetables and pre-cooked chicken. I was amazed at how
quickly it heated up and how evenly it cooked my meal. The non-stick surface is a dream to clean,
which is crucial when you're sharing a communal kitchen sink with an entire floor of students. I've
used it to make everything from scrambled eggs for breakfast to late-night ramen when I'm studying.
The cool-touch handles are a great safety feature, especially in a small space where accidents could
easily happen. One of my favorite things about this appliance is its versatility. Last week, I even
managed to make a small batch of pancakes for a weekend brunch with my roommate. The indicator
lights are super helpful - I always know exactly when it's preheated and ready to use. The only
minor drawback I've found is that the cooking surface is a bit small if you're trying to cook for
more than one person. But for individual meals, it's perfect. Overall, this MyMini appliance has
made dorm life so much easier and has allowed me to eat healthier, home-cooked meals instead of
relying on the campus cafeteria. It's definitely been worth every penny!
Sarah Johnson
College Student
In my line of work, I spend a lot of time on the road, staying in various hotels. The MyMini Waffle
Maker has become my trusty companion, adding a touch of home comfort to my travels. When I first
purchased it, I was skeptical about its performance given its small size, but it has exceeded my
expectations in every way. The compact design makes it incredibly easy to pack in my suitcase. It
barely takes up any space, which is crucial when you're living out of a bag. The first time I used
it in a hotel room, I was impressed by how quickly it heated up - in just about 2 minutes, it was
ready to go. I poured in the batter (I usually mix a small batch in a travel container before
leaving home), closed the lid, and in a few minutes, I had a perfectly crisp, golden waffle. What I
love most about this little powerhouse is its versatility. Sure, it makes great waffles, but I've
experimented with other recipes too. One morning, when I was craving something savory, I made a
cheese and herb waffle that turned out delicious. I've even used it to make a quick grilled cheese
sandwich when I didn't feel like going out for dinner. The non-stick surface is a lifesaver.
Cleaning up in a hotel room can be challenging, but with this waffle maker, a quick wipe with a damp
cloth is usually all it needs. The cool-touch handle is another great feature - it gives me peace of
mind when I'm using it in small hotel rooms where space can be tight. One small issue I've
encountered is that the waffle size is quite small, so if you're really hungry, you might need to
make a couple. But for me, that's not a big deal - I'd rather have a compact appliance that I can
easily travel with than a larger one that makes bigger waffles. This MyMini Waffle Maker has truly
transformed my mornings on the road. It's given me the ability to start my day with a warm, homemade
breakfast no matter where I am. The comfort and convenience it provides make those long weeks away
from home a little more bearable. It's become such an essential part of my travel kit that I can't
imagine hitting the road without it now!
Thomas Rodriguez
Traveling Salesman
After downsizing to a smaller apartment, I was on the hunt for compact appliances that wouldn't
clutter my limited counter space. That's when I discovered the MyMini 7 Egg Cooker, and it's been a
delightful addition to my kitchen. Despite its small footprint, this little dynamo has become one of
my most-used appliances. When I first unboxed it, I was impressed by its sleek design and intuitive
controls. The instruction manual was clear and concise, which I greatly appreciated. For my
inaugural use, I decided to make some hard-boiled eggs for a salad. I was amazed at how simple the
process was - I just filled the base with the appropriate amount of water (using the included
measuring cup), placed the eggs in the tray, and turned it on. The indicator light let me know when
the eggs were done, and to my delight, they were cooked to perfection. What I love most about this
egg cooker is its versatility. I've used it to make soft-boiled eggs for my grandson's breakfast
when he visits, medium-boiled eggs for my husband's sandwich lunches, and hard-boiled eggs for
various recipes. The egg white separator that comes with it is a fantastic bonus - it's made
preparing deviled eggs for potlucks so much easier. One feature that I find particularly helpful is
the auto shut-off function. As someone who occasionally gets distracted, it's reassuring to know
that I won't overcook the eggs or leave the appliance running if I forget about it. The non-stick
surface of the egg tray makes cleanup a breeze, which is a big plus for me. I've even found uses for
this appliance beyond just cooking eggs. The steaming tray that comes with it is perfect for
steaming small portions of vegetables. Last week, I used it to steam some broccoli while I was
preparing the rest of my dinner, and it came out perfectly crisp-tender. If I had to mention one
drawback, it would be that the capacity is limited to 7 eggs. When I'm preparing for larger family
gatherings, I sometimes need to do two batches. However, given how quickly it cooks the eggs, this
isn't a significant issue for me. Overall, my MyMini 7 Egg Cooker has become an indispensable part
of my kitchen. It's made preparing healthy, protein-rich meals so much easier, and its compact size
means it doesn't overwhelm my small kitchen. For anyone living in a small space or just looking to
simplify their cooking routine, I can't recommend this appliance enough. It's proof that good things
really do come in small packages!
Emily Milestone
Retired Teacher
